notes: The user clarified that the screenshot did not show a bug. Tentative uncommitted observation-label changes were discarded. All product source, prior HTML builds and the five existing packages remain identical to the approved v21 release.

The repository home now leads with one complete download and clear entry paths. Detailed gameplay/development explanation is preserved in docs/PROJECT_DETAILS.md, with a new docs index. Historical packages, versioned validation reports and branches are retained.

Gaming-the-System-complete.zip contains the connected three-level game and separate Level1/Level1.html, Level2/Level2.html and Level3/Level3.html. START-HERE.html is an offline version chooser; START-HERE.txt provides Chinese and English instructions.

The new complete archive is generated alongside every existing download. Its four playable HTMLs are byte-identical to their corresponding tested individual packages and production builds. All six archive hashes and all HTML hashes are recorded in the manifest.

The actual complete-ZIP launcher opens each version offline and fits 1366px and 320px widths. Desktop and phone screenshots were visually inspected. Production ZIP checks also complete the Level 2 3-to-6-to-10-to-25-to-100 sequence, Level 3 two/optional-third path, standalone Level 1 and connected Level 1-to-2-to-3 with sound and fresh reload behaviour.

Level 2 experiment framing and the unassigned first Level 3 allocation remain included. No gameplay logic, theory endpoint or authored animation script is changed. The completed opening/cinematics have not been merged.

The current packaging suite contains 12 passing checks with no runtime errors. The 75 earlier gameplay checks remain historical validation for the unchanged v21 source; they were not all rerun for this packaging/documentation-only release.
Offline checks serve exact packaged bytes through an in-memory HTTPS route because managed Chromium blocks file navigation. Direct file opening in a particular user browser was not observed.
